correctness.rationale: A run is the cyclic interval triple (start,length,least period) with 2p≤length≤32 and strict one-symbol nonextension both sides. Repeated n-bit windows prohibit a periodic factor of length ≥p+n, hence 2p≤L≤p+4 implies p≤4 and L≤8, so no omitted longer periodic intervals. Built a separate complete enumeration of all 65,536 local incoming/outgoing pairings in the order-four de Bruijn digraph, retained precisely 2048 single 32-edge Euler tours, and independently scanned every start and length 2..8 for least periods and both boundary inequalities. Reproduced r1=8,r2=2 for each cycle, all six joint frequency cells and the distribution of 12/13/14 runs, rather than relying only on packaged VERIFY_OK or profiles.csv. The Euler pairing bijection covers every rotation class uniquely via marked edge 00000. Orbit-cell splits and CSV row-by-row checks were examined in the source program but not independently rerun, so these secondary symmetry numbers have less independent computational confirmation; source source-code derivation and group action were checked.
